text:

Coastal Waters Forecast
National Weather Service Honolulu HI
346 PM HST Wed Jul 22 2026

Hawaiian coastal waters within 40 nautical miles including the
Hawaiian Islands Humpback Whale National Marine Sanctuary.

PHZ100-231430-
346 PM HST Wed Jul 22 2026

.Synopsis for Hawaiian coastal waters...
High pressure far to the northeast of Hawaii will gradually move
southwest and strengthen through Friday. Over the weekend, the
high far north of the state will move westward and gradually
weaken.
